critical_code_review_comments: Dead code: /app/frontend/src/pages/vehicle-tabs/MileageTab.js and ServiceTab.js are still on disk but no longer imported — safe to delete in a cleanup pass.

timeline.py sorts events by ISO date string reverse; works only because dates are stored in canonical ISO format. If any legacy row has a non-ISO date, sort order will drift. Consider defensive parse.

update_project_item filters `v is not None or k in ('description',)` — description=null is allowed to clear the field, but budget/actual_cost=null cannot clear once set. Fine for now, worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests use TEST_ prefixed titles for project items (auto-deleted) and TEST_ fuel logs (auto-deleted). Frontend Playwright created 'TEST_UI_iter49' item and cleaned up via DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 49 fully signed off. Rate limits still active (login 5/min per IP) — batch test runs and sleep 65s between bursts. AuthContext stores JWT under localStorage['sharago_token'] (not 'token' / 'access_token'). Login API returns {token, user}, not {access_token}. Landing language toggle uses [data-testid='landing-lang-toggle']; setting localStorage.i18nextLng alone does not always re-render — click the toggle button. To reach a real vehicle, GET /api/vehicles (the sidebar '+' link /garage/new is a create route, skip it). Fuel UI still deferred to Iter 50.
